post_hoc: [MEASURE] POST-HOC (2026-09-04): read-only derivation from released artifacts for the fix pass; certifies nothing, settles no registered prediction, and no certified quantity descends from it.

composition_20_resplits.note: means over the 20 re-splits of the panel's composition block; the published split (replicate 0) is one of them

head_auc_s_cal.set: S_cal (the 74 calibration hospitals; run_eicu leak probe, head_auc_oos)
head_auc_s_cal.note: the manuscript's 'peaks at 0.867' is this maximum, replicate 4, on S_cal; pool and answered-set AUC come from the out-rev2 re-emission when present

calibration_20_resplits.note: post-hoc panel, descriptive; skill_margin_answered is constant-rule error minus head error on the answered set, i.e. the head's margin over the constant rule

bbse_transfer.note: expected_q_at_observed_prevalence uses the pool's oracle prevalence from the 20-re-split block; a q below it means the auxiliary-split confusion rates do not transfer to the held-out hospitals

published_split.note: published split = replicate 0; the constant survive-everyone rule errs at the answered mortality, so the head's margin over it is answered_mortality - answered_error

p4_signed.rule: an APACHE-absence feature (aps_present, apv_present or an *__missing sibling) in the top 3 of the |gap| ranking
p4_signed.note: a negative gap means the feature carries more attribution on declined stays (the registered leak direction); every exception's gap is positive, so under a signed reading P4 is satisfied on none

information_floor.note: ln(1/delta)(1-alpha)/n at the record-carrying calibration count; a margin in atom units, a feasibility diagnostic, never a gate

e1.note: the influence-cap sweep replays these draws; six validity-grid draws deployed a BBSE threshold and are excluded from Table S4

r_counts.sentence: R = 200 calibration draws unless stated: the label-shift power frontier uses 50 per point, the label-shift magnitude sweep 100, the aleatoric frontier 300; the explanation case study and the coverage-and-composition arm are single draws
